description: This file implements eviction policies for a disk cache, including an in-development enhanced eviction policy that manages entries across multiple usage-based lists (NO_USE, LOW_USE, HIGH_USE, DELETED). It handles cache trimming, entry ranking updates, and eviction logic based on usage and age, with support for delayed trimming and reporting.

classes.name: Eviction
classes.description: Class managing cache eviction policies, including both simple and enhanced (in-development) strategies, handling cache trimming, entry ranking, and eviction based on usage and age.

methods.name: Eviction::Init
methods.description: Initializes the eviction object with backend data, setting parameters and state flags.

methods.name: Eviction::Stop
methods.description: Stops eviction processing, marking the object as busy.

methods.name: Eviction::TrimCache
methods.description: Performs cache trimming based on size and usage, with support for empty cache clearing.

methods.name: Eviction::UpdateRank
methods.description: Updates the rank of an entry in the cache, depending on the eviction policy version.

methods.name: Eviction::OnOpenEntry
methods.description: Handles logic when an entry is opened, updating its usage rank.

methods.name: Eviction::OnCreateEntry
methods.description: Handles logic when a new entry is created, inserting it into ranking lists.

methods.name: Eviction::OnDoomEntry
methods.description: Handles logic when an entry is doomed, removing it from ranking lists.

methods.name: Eviction::OnDestroyEntry
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an entry is destroyed.

methods.name: Eviction::SetTestMode
methods.description: Enables test mode for eviction, altering behavior for testing.

methods.name: Eviction::TrimDeletedList
methods.description: Trims the list of deleted entries.

methods.name: Eviction::PostDelayedTrim
methods.description: Schedules a delayed cache trim.

methods.name: Eviction::DelayedTrim
methods.description: Executes the delayed trim, possibly rescheduling.

methods.name: Eviction::ShouldTrim
methods.description: Determines if cache trimming is needed based on size and delay counters.

methods.name: Eviction::ShouldTrimDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the deleted list should be trimmed based on size.

methods.name: Eviction::ReportTrimTimes
methods.description: Reports timing metrics related to cache trimming.

methods.name: Eviction::GetListForEntry
methods.description: Returns the list (usage category) for a given entry.

methods.name: Eviction::EvictEntry
methods.description: Evicts a cache entry, either by doom or removal, updating rankings.

methods.name: Eviction::TrimCacheV2
methods.description: Performs cache trimming using an enhanced policy with multiple usage lists.

methods.name: Eviction::UpdateRankV2
methods.description: Updates the rank of an entry in the enhanced eviction policy.

methods.name: Eviction::OnOpenEntryV2
methods.description: Handles entry open event in the enhanced policy, updating reuse count and rankings.

methods.name: Eviction::OnCreateEntryV2
methods.description: Handles creation of an entry in the enhanced policy, managing reuse and refetch counts.

methods.name: Eviction::OnDoomEntryV2
methods.description: Handles entry doom event in the enhanced policy, updating state and rankings.

methods.name: Eviction::OnDestroyEntryV2
methods.description: Handles destruction of an entry in the enhanced policy.

methods.name: Eviction::GetListForEntryV2
methods.description: Returns the usage list (NO_USE, LOW_USE, HIGH_USE) for an entry based on reuse count.

methods.name: Eviction::TrimDeleted
methods.description: Trims the deleted entries list, removing old or doomed entries.

methods.name: Eviction::RemoveDeletedNode
methods.description: Removes a node from the deleted list, doomings its entry.

methods.name: Eviction::NodeIsOldEnough
methods.description: Checks if a node's last used time exceeds the threshold for its list.

methods.name: Eviction::SelectListByLength
methods.description: Selects which usage list to trim based on list sizes.

methods.name: Eviction::ReportListStats
methods.description: Reports statistics about usage lists for monitoring.
